    10  
    11  /-!
    12  # Vietoris topology
    13  
    14  This file defines the Vietoris topology on the types of compact subsets and nonempty compact subsets
    15  of a topological space. The Vietoris topology is generated by sets of the form
    16  $\{K \mid K \subseteq U\}$ and $\{K \mid K \cap U \ne \emptyset\}$, where $U$ is an open subset of
    17  the underlying space.
    18  
    19  ## Implementation notes
    20  
    21  Rather than defining the topology directly on `TopologicalSpace.Compacts α`, we first define
    22  `TopologicalSpace.vietoris α` on `Set α`, then we take the subspace topology on
    23  `TopologicalSpace.Compacts α` and `TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts α`. This approach will
    24  let us reuse several results if a type of closed sets equipped with the Vietoris topology is
    25  defined in the future.
    26  
    27  Note that we do not equip `TopologicalSpace.Closeds α` with the Vietoris topology. When `α` is a
    28  metric space, `TopologicalSpace.Closeds α` is equipped with the Hausdorff metric, which is generally
    29  incompatible with the Vietoris topology.
    30  
    31  ## References
    32  
    33  * [Ernest Michael, *Topologies on spaces of subsets*][michael1951]
    34  -/
    35  
    36  @[expose] public section
    37  
    38  open Set Topology
    39  
    40  variable {α β γ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : α → β}
    41  
    42  namespace TopologicalSpace
    43  
    44  variable (α) in
    45  /-- The Vietoris topology on the powerset of a topological space, generated by sets of the form
    46  `{A | A ⊆ U}` and `{A | A ∩ U ≠ ∅}`, where `U` is an open subset of the underlying space. Used for
    47  defining the topologies on `Compacts` and `NonemptyCompacts`. -/
    48  @[instance_reducible]
    49  protected def vietoris : TopologicalSpace (Set α) :=
    50    .generateFrom <| powerset '' {U | IsOpen U} ∪ (fun V => {s | (s ∩ V).Nonempty}) '' {V | IsOpen V}
    51  
    52  attribute [local instance] TopologicalSpace.vietoris
    53  
    54  namespace vietoris
    55  
    56  /-- When `Set` is equipped with the Vietoris topology, the powerset of an open set is open. -/
    57  theorem _root_.IsOpen.powerset_vietoris {U : Set α} (h : IsOpen U) :
    58      IsOpen U.powerset :=
    59    isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem <| .inl ⟨U, h, rfl⟩
    60  
    61  theorem isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen {U : Set α} (h : IsOpen U) :
    62      IsOpen {s | (s ∩ U).Nonempty} :=
    63    isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem <| .inr ⟨U, h, rfl⟩
    64  
    65  /-- When `Set` is equipped with the Vietoris topology, the powerset of a closed set is closed. -/
    66  theorem _root_.IsClosed.powerset_vietoris {F : Set α} (h : IsClosed F) :
    67      IsClosed F.powerset := by
    68    simp_rw [powerset, ← isOpen_compl_iff, compl_ofPred, ← inter_compl_nonempty_iff]
    69    exact isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen h.isOpen_compl
    70  
    71  theorem isClosed_inter_nonempty_of_isClosed {F : Set α} (h : IsClosed F) :
    72      IsClosed {s | (s ∩ F).Nonempty} := by
    73    simp_rw +singlePass [← compl_compl F, inter_compl_nonempty_iff, ← compl_ofPred]
    74    exact h.isOpen_compl.powerset_vietoris.isClosed_compl
    75  
    76  theorem isClopen_singleton_empty : IsClopen {(∅ : Set α)} := by
    77    rw [← powerset_empty]
    78    exact ⟨isClosed_empty.powerset_vietoris, isOpen_empty.powerset_vietoris⟩
